_comment: Copy to workspace/<name>/data/apply-answers.json and fill it in YOURSELF. Claude cannot write this file
(.claude/settings.json denies it), and Ascend never infers these answers. Automatic apply and apply sheets
copy each value exactly as written onto every form that asks. Delete a line to have forms asking it stop
in Needs you instead. Every value below is a placeholder.
Yes/no questions: write Yes or No. Choices (gender, veteran...): write the option as forms show it, for
example Decline To Self Identify. A form whose options do not include your answer stops; nothing is guessed.
disability: I do not want to answer
